newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ELAIS JUMPS AS FIRE BURNS MINERVA.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ELAIS JUMPS AS FIRE BURNS MINERVA.

text.p: Shares of Elais, an edible oils producer, jumped 600 drachmas, 8.0 percent limit up, in high volume, after a major fire broke out at rival Minerva's plant at Schimatari.
The fire which broke out at 8:50 local was still raging but was under control, the fire department told Reuters.
"The cause is still unknown but the fire has destroyed half of the factory," said Michael Panousopoulos, chief of the local fire department.
Fighting the fire were 20 fire trucks and 75 firefighters, he said.
Minerva's plant is located at Schimatari, off the Athens-Lamia national highway.
In mid-session trading, offers of Elais shares had disappeared with the stock bid at 8,100 drachmas.
"The stock's reaction is clearly related to the fire at Minerva's plant," a fund manager said.
Sources at Minerva said the Schimatari facilities included both storage and a production plant.
